sections.title: The home page clock is back!
items: If you've been a long time user, you might know a large clock shown on the home screen above your classes was more recently replaced witht the small pill in the top left corner
This large clock has now been brought back!
By clicking the existing clock, you can now select the 'expanded' view, which replaces the smaller clock on the home page with a much larger clock.
You can click this clock to open a similar menu, where you can adjust size and alignment, or revert back to the smaller clock
**Some of you may also remember there was a 'Your Day' feature which displayed your timetable directly on the home page - If you would like this to return please let me know!

sections.title: Other Changes
items: - Minor visual changes to the folder editing bar
- The clock pill now expands to show settings without moving
- Settings panel buttons now expand to fill the space
- The sidebar scale indicator has been moved above the sidebar scale buttons, and now visually display 'largest' and 'smallest'
- Timetable edit panel appearance has been reverted to be one slab instead of multiple seperate components
- The 'View class work' button has been removed from home page classroom widgets

sections.title: Closing Notes
items: Please report any bugs or request changes through the 'Feedback' button in the settings. Thank you for using Modern Classroom!
